scoring.reach: expected Skill called via Skill tool or its body Read
scoring.misselect: expected not reached and another Skill was called or another ASC body was Read
scoring.unselected: no Skill call and no ASC body Read
scoring.bodyRead: expected body Read (Skill tool alone loads only the entry)
scoring.referenceRead: any listed reference Read (true when none listed)
scoring.applied: bodyRead and referenceRead and all answerAll and (answerAny empty or any matches), case-insensitive
scoring.overapplication: negative case with any Skill call or any ASC body Read
scoring.failure: run error, API error or missing trace; counted separately, never as unselected
